name: drumroll
title: DRUM ROLL step editor for the finger sequencer
summary: The finger sequencer's step editor: shift + blue press on TE's finger screen ('(shift arrow) BLUE: EDITOR') (sequencer key, drum playmode) opens a channel-rack grid of the selected finger pattern in a TE look. A pattern edited there plays with 8 lanes, each one drum sample with its own length (1-64 steps) and rate (1/4 .. 1/32, triplets), drawn to scale with bar / beat lines, loop lines and a playhead per lane; every step has VEL, TONE, LEN, NUDGE, PROB and RATCH, every sample a filter (LP / BP / HP, cutoff, resonance) and a level. TE's finger keys start and stop the patterns: DRUM ROLL follows TE's step events, TE's compressed view shows a summary, TE's step record still works. The 14 patterns, swing and filters are kept in TE's op1.db (table sdk_drumroll); page 6 PAT sets the pattern length for all lanes (TE's length changes do the same) and clears a pattern (asks first). The black keys on TE's drum finger screen are punch-in effects while held, three banks of 10 (green press picks A / B / C): PO-20-style, arcade, time + mix.

call_sites.what: finger player (drum) reads a step's note: step events, DRUM ROLL's patterns -> -1
finger screen: delete the cursor step

controls: finger screen (sequencer key, drum playmode, finger sequencer picked; note '(shift arrow) BLUE: EDITOR' top left): shift + blue press opens DRUM ROLL on the selected finger pattern and closes it (shift + green press closes too)
knob turn = the value under that knob, green press = next page, shift + blue turn = browse lanes; blue press = cursor step on / off (any page); white press = hear the cursor step

P1 STEP: step / ON / VEL / PROB; P2 NOTE: step / TONE / LEN / RATCH; P3 TIME: step / NUDGE / SWING / ZOOM; P4 LANE: SAMPLE / LENGTH / RATE / MUTE; P5 SOUND: FILTER / CUTOFF / RESO / LEVEL; P6 PAT: blue turn = pattern length (all lanes + TE's); blue / white / orange press asks 'CLEAR PATTERN n?' (any knob turn: left NO / right YES, any press: ok)
shift + green turn: finger pattern 1-14; shift + orange press: clear the lane (again: undo); shift + white press does nothing while open
the keyboard stays TE's (pattern keys start the patterns, step record); the view follows TE's selected pattern
the first edit of a finger pattern makes it DRUM ROLL's (8 lanes, all step parameters); TE keeps a summary of it
TE's finger screen: changing a pattern's length sets every DRUM ROLL lane of it to that length (in its rate's steps)

while open: shift + white press = STEP REC on / off: the keyboard plays drums into the cursor step (the first key replaces the step, more add; a drum without a lane gets an empty one), FORWARD / BACK = step on / back
shift + BACK = undo, shift + FORWARD = redo (16 steps; in the editor and on TE's drum finger screen with it closed; TE's own finger screen edits too)

TE's drum finger screen (open or closed), the black keys held = punch-in effects of bank A / B / C (green press on the finger screen with the editor closed: next bank): A FILL RETRIG RETRIG-FAST GLITCH RISE LP-SWEEP HP-SWEEP BLINDS SOLO-1 SOLO-1+2; B 8-BIT LASER FALL COIN RND-PITCH OCT-UP OCT-DOWN ECHO REVERSE SHUFFLE; C HALF-TIME DOUBLE-TIME TRIPLET LOOP-BEAT BUILD SOLO-1-4 SOLO-5-8 NO-KICK FADE CUT; shift + black = TE's step record
status_note: v2.1: punch-ins on both held patterns (TE's taken over while held), repeats loop the last step with a hit; v2.0: punch-in banks A / B / C (green press), new arcade / time effects, shift + black always TE's; v1.9: undo / redo (shift + BACK / FORWARD), TE's finger screen edits too; v1.8: punch-ins reordered, FILL FAST / GLITCH FAST / LP FAST / HP FILTER left out; v1.7: STEP REC; v1.6: punch-ins = the PO-20 arcade's 16 (shift + black for 6), window while held; v1.5: zoom 3.5 bars, shift arrow in the texts, punch-in effects on the black keys (drum finger screen); v1.4: zoom 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 bars; v1.3: shift + blue press opens and closes it, no badge while closed; v1.2: playhead always shown (view follows a held pattern key, TE patterns too, view follows playback); v1.1: blue press opens it (note on the finger screen); pattern length for all lanes (page 6 PAT, follows TE's length); v1.0: DRUM ROLL is the finger sequencer's step editor on the finger screen, 14 finger patterns, DRUM ROLL patterns play with 8 lanes following TE's step events; the drum screen gesture, the engine list row and the own play / tape clock are gone; v0.9 op1.db; v0.3 / v0.1 device-tested (stand-alone)
